verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is a hosted service that stores company records, so a data-training policy or opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The pack contains no documented training opt-out or no-training commitment. The nearest items are adjacent: 'Ultrametric runs no model' and the note that local `--path` context stays local during retrieval. Neither says hosted company data is excluded from AI training, so they earn no credit.
